title: [Prime] MSI RTX 5070 12GB Ventus 2X OC Graphics Card $1029.80 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] MSI RTX 5070 12GB Ventus 2X OC Graphics Card $1029.80 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU

[DogeConomy] Welcome to OzBargain :)
Price in title please
[Clear] I got a ribbon for the 100m sprint in primary school
[cobknob] @Manny Calavera: What position did u finish?
[ksehgal] Same price on https://worldwidepc.com.au/products/gigabyte-geforce-rtx5070…
[Topuszx] Damn how many other retailers are there aside from the big retailers? Do u know where u can find a list of them?
[Sertacv2] Insane how this is similarly priced as the 5060ti 16gb
[Rgh] Probably need to mention it’s a super inflated price and not good value with ATL being closer to $800. But fair enough it’s lowest price by $200 currently for anyone needing it now.
[SpamtonG Spamton] is this even worth it? when you can get a 9070 xt with 4 more gb for around the same cost
[MichaelJosem] Depends what you're using it for.
Various AI workloads would likely benefit from being on the nvidia. You'll probably get more FPS on a high-resolution monitor (like 1440p or so) with the 9070.
[Jazza2400] The best time to buy was last year, but if you need a card and have the cash, buy it. It won't be going down anytime soon. Probably better off with a 9070xt but if you want team green it's your money.
